say:4:1141106003:1.text: For Maulers, all fights are about resources in this desert. The winner will live, and the defeated will die of hunger.
say:4:1141106003:1.source_cn: 在蛮血们看来，沙漠中的每一场争斗都与抢夺资源有关。赢的...

say:5:1141106004:1.text: A strong adversary in this case has nothing to do with recognition and admiration.
say:5:1141106004:1.source_cn: 这种争斗下的劲敌，和认同与钦佩无关。
say:5:1141106004:1.male: A strong adversary in this case has nothing to do with recognition and admiration.
say:5:1141106004:1.female: A strong adversary in this case has nothing to do with recognition and admiration.

say:6:1141106006:1.text: Too many fights in this desert end in lives lost.
say:6:1141106006:1.source_cn: 沙漠中的争斗，很多时候要付出生命的代价。
say:6:1141106006:1.male: Too many fights in this desert end in lives lost.

say:7:1141106007:1.text: But I don't like it. Warriors temper their skills in combat...
say:7:1141106007:1.source_cn: 但我对此并不认同。战士们的技巧需要不断地在战斗中磨炼……

say:8:1141106008:1.text: It's a shame to see a promising young warrior go down in a brutal fight.
say:8:1141106008:1.source_cn: 残酷的斗争会过早地扼杀有潜质的战士，这未免太过可惜。
